story: An icon of the skies, the Sri Lanka Wood Pigeon (Aquila nipalensis) is a species from the Accipitridae family. It thrives in Open plains; grasslands; deserts; steppes; savannah; and low hills, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Endangered (EN), the Sri Lanka Wood Pigeon is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Sri Lanka Wood Pigeon helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife. This poster is a celebration of the Sri Lanka Wood Pigeon, a bird that inspires wonder and highlights the critical importance of conservation efforts.
